Attune 0.0.13 fixes silent update failures and tidies the Updates page.

The macOS updater now carries its bundled libraries. Attune confirms that the update helper starts before quitting, reports startup failures, and discards incomplete downloads. Packaged updater startup is checked on every supported platform before release.

The activity icon is hidden on settings-related pages, including Updates.

If an older installed version cannot finish an update, install this release manually over the existing app. Your library stays in place.
